description: This Python source file provides utility functions for setting up and testing a proxy server in a software project. It includes functions to build cache configuration, create minimal proxy configuration, set environment variables, and instantiate a FastAPI test client with appropriate configurations, including Redis cache and database settings.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] build_cache_config(enable_cache: bool = True)
methods.description: Constructs Redis cache configuration based on environment variables and an enable flag.

methods.name: Dict build_minimal_proxy_config(database_url: Optional[str] = None, **init_options)
methods.description: Generates a minimal proxy configuration dictionary as YAML, optionally including database URL and cache settings.

methods.name: None set_proxy_environment_variables(monkeypatch, database_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Sets environment variables for database URL and Redis connection parameters using pytest monkeypatch.

methods.name: TestClient create_proxy_test_client(monkeypatch, database_url: Optional[str] = None, **init_options)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a FastAPI TestClient for proxy testing, configuring environment variables and server settings based on provided options.
